notes.title: Demo update v.32
notes.content:
Howdy everyone~!!

Todays update is came from feedbacks during the Steam Next Fest so Check it out~!!

Added new Healing Orb
Fixed an issue with enemy hitbox judge error.
New Healing Orbs are drops as a reward of battle, or from destroying barrels.

+5, +10 from destroying barrels "Chance"

There is many surprise(?) are waiting with barrels so feel free to check it out~!!



That's all for today, I hope you guys have a great day~!!

notes.title: Update note Demo v.30
notes.content:
Howdy everyone~!!

Today I updated my game for more balance and improvement with parry.
Let's check it out!

Increase Enemies delay of attack judge.
Increase Clair's Parry Cool Time.
Fixed some Dialogue error.
Added Information about Power attack during tutorial.
Changed some map objects.


Thank you so much with all the feedbacks that you gave it to me~!!

The current Parry's problem was feels bit delayed. but the parry judge's are starts from frame 0 / which is starts as soon as press the key.

The real problem was from enemies hitbox judge, I believe it's starts faster for everyone to react.
So I decide to delay the attack judge start point 2 frame slower.

But also I felt like the parry is too much easier now so I decide to nurf it with add some more cooldown.

I hope this will improve the feeling of parry and wish to know more opinion about the changes.

That's all for today, I hope you guys have a great day~!!
